privacy.title: What TRAIVEL does with your data
privacy.intro: TRAIVEL is a solo-built portfolio project, not a company. This page describes what actually happens to your data when you use it.

collected.heading: What's collected
collected.body: If you sign in, your email address and (for Google sign-in) your name and avatar are stored via Supabase Auth. Trip briefs you submit (destination, dates, interests, budget) and the itineraries generated from them are stored so you can revisit and share your trips. Anonymous, signed-out use is also supported and doesn't require an account.

thirdParty.heading: Third-party services
thirdParty.body: Generating an itinerary sends your trip brief to Anthropic's Claude API. Place names are checked against the Google Places API and Open-Meteo for weather; YouTube Data API is used for trend signals. Payments (Premium plan) are processed by Stripe — TRAIVEL never sees or stores your card details. None of your data is sold to third parties.

controls.heading: Your controls
controls.body: You can delete your trips from the My Trips page. To delete your account entirely or ask any question about your data, email

terms.title: The short version
terms.intro: TRAIVEL is a solo-built portfolio project, provided as-is with no warranty of any kind.

usingItinerary.heading: Using the itinerary
usingItinerary.body: Itineraries are AI-generated and cross-checked against Google Places and weather data at the time they're created, but places can close, change hours, or stop existing. Always double-check opening hours, prices, and availability before you rely on a stop — especially for anything time-sensitive or booked in advance.

billing.heading: Premium plan & billing
billing.body: Premium subscriptions are billed and managed through Stripe. You can view invoices, update your payment method, or cancel anytime from the billing portal linked on the Pricing page — cancelling stops future charges but doesn't retroactively refund the current billing period.

noWarranty.heading: No warranty
noWarranty.body: TRAIVEL is offered without warranties of any kind, express or implied. It's not liable for travel decisions made based on its output. If something looks broken or wrong, email
